entities.summary: Agnes Margrétardóttir Sigurðardóttir is an Icelandic prelate who was the Bishop of Iceland from 2012 to 2024. She is the first woman to be elected a Bishop of the Church of Iceland, which happened in 2012; she took office as such in the same year.
